svg.title: Historic Provincial Library & Archives emblem - Victoria, B.C.
svg.desc: Faithful cleaned vector reconstruction from the supplied raster engraving. Original ornamental lettering is retained as editable outlines. Transparent exterior, opaque white interiors, and black engraving. Cubic Bezier paths only; no embedded images, raster effects, or font dependencies. Automatic contour fitting with selective grain cleanup and visual verification; not an assertion of original master artwork. White backings repair patchy transparency within the enclosed crown caps and central highlight of the supplied cutout; genuine exterior apertures remain transparent.
svg.metadata: { "source": "Historic Provincial Library & Archives Emblem(1).png", "sourceSize": [ 1116, 1410 ], "method": "subpixel contour reconstruction with cubic Bezier fitting, separate opaque support and ink, and original outlined lettering", "parameters": { "name": "provincial-library-archives", "threshold": 140.0, "blur": 0.26, "hole_area": 0.18, "speck_area": 0.2, "tolerance": 0.14, "scale": 3, "shading_threshold": 108.0, "clean_lettering": true }, "engine": "potracelib 1.16" }
